product_one_liner.value: Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform for business, technology, and analytics teams that helps them detect digital-experience issues, diagnose customer friction, and prioritize improvements by business impact.
product_one_liner.notes: Summarizes the company’s platform description and its monitor, diagnose, and optimize capabilities.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing-plans page exists and describes custom plans.

named_customers.notes: BMO is featured in a customer case study and Virgin Atlantic appears in the customer-logo section.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company history gives 2015 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Senior Solutions Engineer Skyler Bailey authored at least two technical posts: one explains the architecture of Quantum Metric’s MCP server, and another describes connecting its experience data and MCP server to a coding agent.

public_docs.notes: Quantum Metric University publicly provides multiple product-learning courses, including platform navigation, data basics, segmentation, and session replay.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current openings list includes account executives, solutions engineers, and a strategy VP role, but no AI, ML, or data-science role title.

model_provider.notes: The official Felix Agentic FAQ says it is powered by Google Gemini.

compliance_certs.notes: The company security page names SOC 2 attestation, ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and GDPR compliance; its references to PCI and HIPAA concern customers’ compliance, not Quantum Metric certifications.

last_funding.notes: The latest disclosed priced financing is the $200 million Series B in January 2021. A database lists a later unamounted accelerator entry in 2022; the value here follows the funding histories identifying the last disclosed financing round.

raised_18mo.notes: Available funding histories place the latest disclosed financing before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; even the separate unamounted accelerator entry is dated March 2022.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings page lists Enterprise Account Executive and Strategic Account Executive, BFSI.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced its Summer 2026 product capabilities on July 16, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated executive-movements record reports that CMO Efrat Ravid left in April 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Quantum Metric growth-marketing job post names these systems in its description of the marketing technology stack; this is a visible job-post signal.
